subject: LAB-015
check: Fixture scoring, pre-loader memory and license refusal, cancellation, authorization, stale reset and duplicate requests
steps: 22 tests in six suites; fixture-os supplied to report; in-memory OperationService with GrantAuthorizationPolicy
Inspect BenchScoreTests, ModelGateTests, FixtureExecutorTests, BenchRecorderTests, BoundaryTests, BenchQualificationTests output

outcome.detail: All 22 tests passed. Cold 31000000 ns and warm 9000000 ns stay separate; mixed reports throw mixedThermal. A wrong answer at 1 ns throws failedTask and cannot change the passing score. A 4000000000-byte model against 1000 bytes throws exceedsMemory with zero loader calls. Unreviewed license and cancellation before allocation also call the loader zero times. A model tool cannot record; a missing reset grant leaves the report. Duplicate recording returns the original receipt. Stale reset returns conflict and preserves the changed item; fresh reset succeeds. Retry after reset returns the original receipt and does not restore the archived item. LiveModelBench throws liveModelUnavailable; fixture completes.

limitations: Package fixture tests on arm64 macOS 27.0 (26A425), Swift 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1). The SDK was measured separately through labr; this record was transcribed from actual test output, not attached by the app.
No physical mobile device, simulator experiment interaction, assistive technology or model inference ran. Scripted latencies are not hardware performance.
Memory gate validates caller-declared model bytes and budget, not real memory pressure. Cancellation is a sleeping injected loader.
Initial uncommitted test compile failed on a ValidationError crossing a typed BenchError boundary; corrected before the passing run at 22a9cf0.
